verdict.rationale: Greptile supports team-specific enforcement via custom rules ('custom standards'), a repo-level greptile.json config file that overrides dashboard settings, and adjustable strictness, plus implicit learning from thumbs up/down feedback. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm AST-pattern-based rule definitions or linking external style guide documents — only natural-language custom rules and JSON config are documented. Missing for 10: explicit AST pattern rule support, explicit support for linking/importing external style guide docs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that custom rules are reliably enforced.
